checks.name: Ubuntu 24.04 LTS
checks.fix: This machine must run Ubuntu 24.04 LTS (not 24.10 or newer). Ask IT before upgrading or reinstalling.

checks.name: CPU architecture
checks.fix: The service images are built for x86_64 (amd64); ARM machines are not supported.

checks.name: Java 21 (Temurin or OpenJDK)
checks.fix: Temurin: 'sdk list java', then 'sdk install java <21.x.y>-tem' and 'sdk default java <21.x.y>-tem'. OpenJDK: 'sudo apt install openjdk-21-jdk'. JAVA_HOME must point to the same Java. Open a new terminal afterwards.

checks.name: Maven 3.9
checks.fix: 'sdk install maven 3.9.11' and 'sdk default maven 3.9.11'. For a project's wrapper: './mvnw wrapper:wrapper -Dmaven=3.9.11', then commit the change.

checks.name: Docker Engine
checks.fix: 'sudo apt-get update && sudo apt-get install docker-ce docker-ce-cli containerd.io' from Docker's apt repository (docs.docker.com/engine/install/ubuntu). If the daemon is not running: 'sudo systemctl start docker'.

checks.name: Node.js
checks.fix: 'nvm install 22 && nvm alias default 22', then open a new terminal and start kitout from it.

checks.name: Memory (MB)
checks.enforceFrom: <<REPLACE: day from which this blocks, e.g. 2026-12-01; until then it only warns>>
checks.fix: 16 GB of RAM are needed to run the stack and a native build. Ask IT for a memory upgrade.
